batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground vulnerabilities page v0.2.0
batch_node.description: The /playground/vulnerabilities story page: three lanes of cards and charts over the compliance_core vulnerability, scanner and finding nodes (what is open, whether it is being exploited, where it lives and what is done), and the /playground/vulnerabilities/detail page that keeps the seven raw alert tables. Charts and cards read Searches; nothing names a scanner, a node id or a value.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities dependabot
node.description: Every open Dependabot alert on the grid, most severe first (req-rampart-20x-playground-page-vulnerabilities). Envelope mode, so the table receives each node with its typed fields.

node.name: Dependabot
node.description: The Dependabot open alerts of unified-systems-com/tap, most severe first. Click the Severity or State heading to sort by it.

node.name: What is open
node.description: Every open finding that concerns a published vulnerability, as the scanners report it today. How many, how severe, and w

config.text: Every open finding that concerns a published vulnerability, as the scanners report it today. How many, how severe, and who found them.

node.name: Open findings
node.description: The open findings that concern a vulnerability, and the highest CVSS score among them.

node.name: playground — story card-open
node.description: Open findings that concern a vulnerability, and the highest CVSS score among them.

query: RETURN COUNT(f) AS findings, MAX(v.data.cvss_score) AS top

node.name: How severe: CVSS score
node.description: Open findings by the CVSS base score of their vulnerability. Colours follow the usual bands: low, medium, high, critical.

config.aria_label: Open findings by CVSS base score

node.name: playground — story cvss-spread
node.description: Open findings by the CVSS base score of their vulnerability.

query: RETURN v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, COUNT(f) AS n

node.name: Who found them
node.description: Open findings by the scanner that reported them.

node.name: playground — story found-by
node.description: Open findings by the scanner that reported them.

query: RETURN s.data.name AS scanner, COUNT(f) AS c

node.name: Is anyone exploiting it?
node.description: Whether the vulnerabilities behind the open findings are known to be used in attacks, by CISA's own catalog and its expl

config.text: Whether the vulnerabilities behind the open findings are known to be used in attacks, by CISA's own catalog and its exploitation assessment, and where each one sits by severity and age.

node.name: On the CISA exploited list
node.description: Open findings whose vulnerability is on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

node.name: playground — story card-kev
node.description: Open findings whose vulnerability is on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

query: MATCH (f:compliance_core__compliance_finding)-[:CONCERNS_COMPLIANCE_VULNERABILITY__compliance_core]->(v:compliance_core__compliance_vulnerability) WHERE f.data.status = "open" AND v.data.kev = true

node.name: CISA exploitation assessment
node.description: Open findings by the exploitation value in CISA's SSVC assessment of their vulnerability. Not observed means CISA has no assessment on record.

config.aria_label: Open findings by CISA SSVC exploitation assessment

node.name: playground — story exploitation
node.description: Open findings by CISA's SSVC exploitation assessment of their vulnerability.

query: RETURN v.data.ssvc_exploitation AS exploitation, COUNT(f) AS c

node.name: Severity against age
node.description: Each dot is one vulnerability with an open finding: when it was published against its CVSS score. Bigger dots have more findings.

config.aria_label: Vulnerabilities with an open finding, by publication time and CVSS score

node.name: playground — story risk-map
node.description: One row per vulnerability with an open finding: its score, publication time and how many findings it has.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.published_at AS published, COUNT(f) AS n

entity.name: Where it lives, and what is done

node.name: Where it lives, and what is done
node.description: Which components carry the open findings, and how much has already been fixed or dismissed. The full list of alerts is o

config.text: Which components carry the open findings, and how much has already been fixed or dismissed. The full list of alerts is on the detail page at /playground/vulnerabilities/detail.

node.name: Already closed
node.description: Findings that are no longer open: fixed or dismissed at the source.

node.name: playground — story card-closed
node.description: Findings that are no longer open: fixed or dismissed at the source.

entity.name: Components with the most open findings

node.name: Components with the most open findings
node.description: The ten components carrying the most open findings.

config.aria_label: Open findings by component, top ten

node.name: playground — story top-components
node.description: The components with the most open findings.

query: RETURN c.data.name AS component, COUNT(f) AS c

node.name: Open findings by ecosystem
node.description: Open findings per component, grouped by the package ecosystem; the area is the number of findings.

config.aria_label: Open findings by ecosystem and component

node.name: playground — story component-tree
node.description: Open findings per component, grouped by ecosystem.

query: RETURN c.data.ecosystem AS ecosystem, c.data.name AS component, COUNT(f) AS c

node.name: Open and closed, by scanner
node.description: Every finding each scanner has reported, split into still open and already closed.

config.aria_label: Findings by scanner, open and resolved

node.name: playground — story remediation
node.description: Every finding by scanner and whether it is still open.

query: RETURN s.data.name AS scanner, f.data.status AS status, COUNT(f) AS c

node.name: Vulnerabilities
node.description: What the scanners found, whether it is being used against anyone, where it lives and how much is already fixed. Charts first; every alert is on the detail page.
